caption: The drawing consists of three main objects and a small measurement scale in a rectangular light beige frame. In the lower portion of the drawing, a pair of tongs with long handles and circular, flat plates on one end are depicted in gray tones, with detailing indicating metal texture. The handles are elongated and intersect near the middle, one handle ending in a loop and the other in a small knobbed tip. Above the tongs, two decorated circular disks are illustrated, each showing intricate symmetrical patterns. The left disk features a central rosette with surrounding geometric floral motifs and a border made of lines and patterns. The right disk displays a central starburst design encircled by small floral shapes and a leafy border. Between the two disks is a short horizontal scale marked in increments labeled 0, 2, 4, 6, and 8, representing inches. The background has faint, uneven brownish stains and the lower left corner includes a small handwritten label. The overall drawing is monochromatic in grayscale with additional aged discoloration.
title: Wafer Iron
